title: FXAA vs SMAA Anti-Aliasing Comparison
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js (via CDN, r152+) that implements a split-screen FXAA vs SMAA anti-aliasing comparison tool with full post-processing pipeline control.

SCENE SETUP:
- Create a scene with objects that strongly reveal aliasing artifacts: a white wireframe icosahedron (radius 2, detail 1), a set of 5 thin diagonal lines made from CylinderGeometry (radius 0.02, height 6) rotated at various angles (15°, 30°, 45°, 60°, 75°), a checkerboard-textured plane (20x20, generated procedurally with 40x40 checks), and a small text sprite reading 'AA TEST' positioned above the icosahedron.
- Use a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 5, 12) looking at origin.
- Add one DirectionalLight (intensity 1.0, position 5,10,5) and AmbientLight (intensity 0.3).
- Background color: #1a1a2e.

RENDERING PIPELINE:
- Use THREE.EffectComposer from the postprocessing addons.
- Create TWO separate EffectComposers sharing the same scene/camera:
  1. composerFXAA: RenderPass -> ShaderPass(FXAAShader) -> ShaderPass(GammaCorrectionShader)
  2. composerSMAA: RenderPass -> SMAAPass -> ShaderPass(GammaCorrectionShader)
- Also maintain a reference plain renderer path (no AA) for comparison.
- The viewport is split vertically: left half renders one method, right half renders the other.
- A draggable vertical divider (DOM element, 4px wide, white, full height) controls the split position. Default at 50%.
- Label each side with a DOM overlay showing the current AA method name in white text (top-left and top-right corners).

INTERACTION:
- Keyboard '1': Set left side to 'None' (no AA)
- Keyboard '2': Set left side to 'FXAA'
- Keyboard '3': Set left side to 'SMAA'
- Keyboard '4': Set right side to 'None'
- Keyboard '5': Set right side to 'FXAA'
- Keyboard '6': Set right side to 'SMAA'
- Keyboard 'R': Reset to default (left=FXAA, right=SMAA, divider at 50%, camera to initial position)
- Keyboard 'P': Toggle pixel-zoom mode. When active, render a 4x magnified inset (200x200px) at the bottom-right corner showing the area around screen center.
- Mouse drag on divider: move split position (clamp 10%-90%).
- Keyboard ArrowLeft/ArrowRight: rotate the scene objects around Y axis by 5 degrees per press (accumulate rotation).
- A DOM button labeled 'Swap Sides' that swaps left and right AA methods.

FXAA RESOLUTION UNIFORM:
- The FXAAShader requires resolution uniform. Set it to (1/width, 1/height) and update on resize.

SMAAPass SETUP:
- SMAAPass needs (width, height) constructor args. Recreate or update on resize.

HUD:
- Top-center: display current left and right method names, e.g., 'FXAA | SMAA'
- Bottom-left: display current scene rotation in degrees (mod 360)
- Bottom-center: display divider position as percentage
- Show 'ZOOM: ON/OFF' indicator when pixel-zoom is toggled.

STATE MANAGEMENT (CRITICAL):
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ updated every frame with:
- leftMethod: string ('None'|'FXAA'|'SMAA') - current left side AA method
- rightMethod: string ('None'|'FXAA'|'SMAA') - current right side AA method
- dividerPosition: number (0.0 to 1.0) - normalized split position
- sceneRotationDeg: number - accumulated Y rotation in degrees (mod 360)
- pixelZoomActive: boolean - whether zoom inset is showing
- composerLeftEnabled: boolean - whether left composer is actively rendering
- composerRightEnabled: boolean - whether right composer is actively rendering
- frameCount: number - incremented each animation frame
- fxaaResolutionX: number - current FXAA resolution uniform X value
- fxaaResolutionY: number - current FXAA resolution uniform Y value
- smaaWidth: number - SMAA pass width
- smaaHeight: number - SMAA pass height
- cameraPositionZ: number - camera Z position
- objectCount: number - number of mesh objects in the scene
- swapCount: number - how many times sides have been swapped
- resetCount: number - how many times reset has been triggered
- lastKeyPressed: string - last key that triggered an action
physics_constraints: No physics simulation. Rendering constraints: FXAA resolution uniforms must match 1/canvasWidth and 1/canvasHeight exactly. SMAA dimensions must match renderer dimensions. Divider position clamped [0.1, 0.9]. Scene rotation accumulates modulo 360. Split rendering must use scissor/viewport correctly so each half only shows its respective AA method.
